themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are ramping up regional and national election campaigns while navigating poll swings and potential coalition pacts. Coverage highlights competitive campaign maneuvers in Spain's 29-N elections, early positioning for France's 2027 presidential race, program formulation for Germany's upcoming regional elections, and electoral strategy debates in Argentina, Norway, and the UK.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing platforms in Germany, Spain, and the UK are converging around explicit 'national priority' framing and aggressive demands for forced returns or remigration. Hardline immigration policies targeting foreign benefits and border enforcement remain core themes used to rally base supporters.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK advocates banning student loans and tightening welfare rules for non-UK nationals.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Far-right movements across several nations face intensifying legal investigations, judicial rulings, and potential regulatory bans, prompting fierce allegations of political persecution. Figures in Brazil, France, Germany, and Poland frame judicial and state oversight as institutional warfare designed to delegitimize conservative leadership.

themes.title: Transnational Friction Over US-Russia Foreign Policy
themes.blurb: Trump's foreign policy stances and interactions with Vladimir Putin are creating significant friction among international conservative allies. British right-wing figures are explicitly distancing themselves from Washington's stance, while French right-wing leaders maintain a cautious stance on foreign entanglements.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Senior Reform UK figures like Richard Tice strongly reject Trump's positive framing of Putin, declaring Putin is not a friend.
